name: Tutorial / screencast
description: On-screen explanation: silences cut, zooms on the relevant area, step texts.
structure: what we're going to do → numbered steps → result
rules:
# Tutorial
- Announce the result at the start (show the final result for 3-5 s).
- Cut silences, mistakes and waiting (speed up loading).
- Zoom on the part of the screen being discussed; a boxed text ("encadre" text style) for each step ("Step 2: …").
- Readable subtitles, no comedic sound effects, very discreet music.
